received_proposals.exact_message: I reaffirm commitment to producing 16 units each. This maintains our profitable cartel at $52 price, yielding $768 per firm. I commit to this quota if others reciprocate.
I propose an unequal split: A=8, B=8, C=32 units per round for rounds 9 through 13 only. This allocation redistributes existing profits without changing the total. Please accept this explicit offer.
